node.title: Paper D v13.2 near-rational support-wise payment
node.statement: REFUTED: common codeword-pair proximity produced by two low-d1 slopes does not imply that no slope is support-wise MCA-bad. The smooth rate-half RS[F_17,mu_8,4] witness invalidates the support inference. A second smooth rate-half RS[F_17,mu_16,8] witness has two support-wise bad slopes while every line word is within distance w=2 of the zero codeword, so it falsifies the former displayed +1 inequality itself. The corrected proved replacement is the 2w charge in v13_2_near_rational_supportwise_two_anchor_payment.
